title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Temporary Accounts Assistant
Nottingham
Office based - 1 day work from home after successful training period

Eaton Syalon are working with our Nottingham based client to recruit a temporary Accounts Assistant into their Finance team. The role will be initially a 3-month temporary role, reporting into the Head Of Finance. You'll support with a mix of transactional accounts work, whilst support the Head of Finance with Month-end tasks.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assist with the month end accounts preparation
- Prepare and post monthly accruals, prepayments, correction and other month end journals as required
- Ownership of the Accounts Payable inbox
- Ownership of supplier queries and providing timely internal and external responses
- Ownership of maintaining the Accounts Payable tracker
- Raise Purchase Orders as required
- Support with producing monthly balance sheet account reconciliations
- Support any upcoming transitions into new systems and tools
- Support with raising sales invoices with the Revenue Accountant
- Support with maintaining customer contracts in the Finance system
- Support with bank reconciliations and postings
- Assist with Accounts Receivable aged debt collection
- Assist with cashflow reporting
- Support VAT return preparation

Person Profile:
- Will have varied transactional / month-end experience, most likely having worked as an Accounts Assistant / Assistant Accountant or Assistant Management Accountant most recently
- Strong Excel skills
- SAP experience preferred but isn't essential
- The ability to hold conversations with all levels of business
- Must be able to commit to the initial 3-month temporary period
- Must be available to start week commencing 2nd November

If you have the above experience and are looking for a temporary role to start at the beginning of November, please get in touch to discuss the role further.

title: Credit Control Administrator
description:
As a Credit Control Administrator, you'll support the accounting and finance team by managing customer accounts and ensuring timely payments. This temporary role in an industrial estate setting is key to maintaining smooth financial operations within the industrial and manufacturing industry.

Client Details

An organisation within the industrial and manufacturing sector, based in Colwick. This is an office based role.

Description
- Monitor and manage customer accounts to ensure payments are up to date.
- Handle queries related to invoices and payments with professionalism and efficiency.
- Prepare and issue reminders for overdue accounts.
- Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies.
- Work closely with the finance team to maintain accurate records.
- Assist in generating reports on outstanding debts and payment trends.
- Provide administrative support to the credit control team as required.
- Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in all financial transactions.

Profile

A successful Credit Control Administrator should have:
- Previous experience in an accounting or finance-related role.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- A problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.

Job Offer
- Hourly rate of £13.00 to £14.00, dependent on the level of experience.
- Temporary position within the industrial and manufacturing industry.
- Convenient location in Colwick.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Finance Officer
company: Worksop College and Ranby House - Agency - Permanent
description:
Finance Officer

Location: Worksop, Nottinghamshire

Working pattern: Full-time, permanent

Start date: As soon as possible

Closing date: Friday 16 October 2026

About the role

Worksop College and Ranby House is a single school community spread across two sites, educating children aged two to eighteen. The school has excellent facilities in a beautiful setting, and it values every pupil's individual strengths, whether academic, sporting, musical or creative.

As Finance Officer, you will support the Head of Finance with the school's transactional accounting. You will look after the purchase ledger, process purchase orders, invoices and expenses, and help with cash management and bank reconciliations. The department's records need to be up to date every day so that reports are accurate and on time. You will also be the first point of contact for pupils and staff who come to the finance office.

What you'll be doing
- Maintaining the purchase ledger daily and inputting invoices accurately into the accounting software
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving any discrepancies
- Making sure purchase orders are authorised by the right budget holder and matched to invoices
- Reviewing the purchase ledger regularly and resolving supplier queries
- Handling pupil pocket money requests and reconciliations
- Maintaining and reconciling cash accounts and floats
- Banking cash and cheques promptly
- Acting as the front desk for the finance department, helping pupils and staff
- Collecting and distributing the department's post each day
- Keeping records in line with school policies and audit requirements
- Following financial regulations, policies and procedures

What you'll bring

Essential:
- Experience using Microsoft Excel
- Experience of processing bank requisitions and petty cash
- Good numeracy and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail
- The ability to work on your own and as part of a team
- A commitment to confidentiality and to handling sensitive information carefully
- The ability to manage and prioritise a high volume of work
- A positive, enthusiastic attitude
- Excellent interpersonal, communication and organisational skills

Desirable:
- Experience in a school or education setting
- Knowledge of financial systems
- AAT Level 3 or equivalent, or willingness to work towards it

What's on offer
- Fee concessions for your children
- Workplace pension scheme
- Access to the gym, sports hall and swimming pool
- Free meals when on duty
- Free onsite parking

Additional information

Applications will be reviewed as they arrive, and the school may close the vacancy early, so please apply soon.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

The school is committed to safeguarding children. All offers of employment depend on satisfactory child protection screening. This includes references, online searches, prohibition checks and an enhanced DBS check with a Barred List check.

The post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. Applicants must declare all convictions and cautions, including those that are spent, unless they are protected under the DBS filtering rules.

Worksop College is an equal opportunities employer. It appoints, trains and promotes people on merit and ability, regardless of age, disability gender reassignment, pregnancy, maternity, marital or civil partnership status, race, sexual orientation, trade union membership, religion or belief.

You may have experience of the following: Finance Assistant, Purchase Ledger Clerk, Accounts Payable Clerk, Accounts Assistant, School Finance Officer, Purchase Ledger Assistant, Finance Administrator, Accounts Payable Officer, Bookkeeper, Finance and Admin Officer

title: Legal Aid Billing Coordinator

- Regular company events and team activities.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Legal Aid Billing Coordinator or Legal Aid Costs professional looking to join a respected law firm with genuine career development opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.
